title: MP Anganwadi Merit List 2026
organization: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
postName: Anganwadi Worker & Helper – Phase-1 Provisional Merit List 2026
vacancyDetails: 2548 Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts (Phase-1); district-wise provisional merit lists
qualification: As per WCD MP Anganwadi Worker / Helper eligibility (10th/12th and local criteria as notified)
ageLimit: As per WCD Madhya Pradesh recruitment rules
selectionProcess: Online Application → Merit List (educational marks / criteria) → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, domicile, category certificate, residence proof of concerned Anganwadi area, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://chayan.mponline.gov.in
2. Open WCD Anganwadi Merit section
3. Select Worker or Helper merit list (General / Special category)
4. Choose division/district and download list
5. Check name and follow DV schedule if shortlisted
shortDescription: MP WCD has released Phase-1 Anganwadi Worker & Helper Provisional Merit List 2026 for 2548 posts on 22 July 2026 at chayan.mponline.gov.in.
content:
The Directorate of Women & Child Development (WCD), Madhya Pradesh has released the provisional merit list for Anganwadi Worker and Helper recruitment (Phase-1) on 22 July 2026.

Highlights

  • Posts: 2,548 (Worker & Helper)
  • Separate lists for General and Special categories
  • District / division wise lists on MP Online Chayan portal

Candidates should verify details carefully and prepare documents for verification. Portal: chayan.mponline.gov.in.
